title: Pure Number: Onomat Utopia
summary: Since Number is an Extra Deck Xyz series with no Main Deck engine of its own, this is the page's Onomat Utopia build: the Zubaba, Gagaga, Gogogo, and Dododo engine paired with ZS - Ascended Sage and Astraltopia to spam Rank 4 Utopia and Number bosses.

summary.title: Starters
points: Onomatopaira sends 1 card from the hand to the GY to add up to 2 monsters from different Onomat families (Zubaba, Gagaga, Gogogo, Dododo) from the Deck to the hand.

Zubababa Knight searches a Zubaba monster on summon and copies its Level, then searches a Gagaga when detached from an Xyz; Dodododo Warrior sends a Dododo from the Deck to the GY to Special Summon itself as a Level 4 and searches a Zubaba when detached.
ZS - Ascended Sage Special Summons itself when you control no cards, and searches a Rank-Up-Magic Normal Spell (Hyper Rank-Up-Magic Utopiforce) when used to Xyz Summon a Utopia monster.
Utopic Onomatopoeia and Onomatokage are each treated as Zubaba, Gagaga, Gogogo, and Dododo cards at all times, unlocking every family condition at once.

summary.title: Opening: ZS - Ascended Sage + Any Level 4 Onomat
steps: Special Summon ZS - Ascended Sage on an empty field, summon a Level 4 Onomat (such as Zubababa Knight or Utopic Onomatopoeia), and overlay into Number 39: Utopia, Emissary of Light (or ZS - Utopic Sage first to summon Astraltopia, then a Utopia); Ascended Sage searches Hyper Rank-Up-Magic Utopiforce.

Activate Hyper Rank-Up-Magic Utopiforce targeting the Rank 4 Utopia to Xyz Summon Rank 12 Number 99: Utopia Dragonar, and use Onomat extenders (Zubababancho Gagagacoat, Dodododwarf Gogogoglove, Gagaga Ganbara Knight) to make two more Rank 4s into Number F0: Utopic Future and Number F0: Utopic Draco Future.

Detach 2 materials from Number 99: Utopia Dragonar on your turn and again on the opponent's turn to Special Summon Number 38: Hope Harbinger Dragon Titanic Galaxy (and another Number 1–100) from the Extra Deck, while Utopiforce in the GY attaches itself as material to the summoned Xyz.

summary.title: 2026 Onomat Detach Chain
summary.text: The newer Onomat monsters trigger when detached from an Xyz Monster to activate its effect: Zubababa Knight searches a Gagaga, Gagaga Ganbara Knight searches a Gogogo, Gogogo Goblindbergh searches a Dododo, and Dodododo Warrior searches a Zubaba. Gagaga Girl - Cell Phone Subtraction can also Xyz Summon as a Quick Effect when the opponent summons from the Extra Deck and sets an opposing monster's ATK to 0 when detached.

summary.title: Number Bosses & Control
points: Number 99: Utopia Dragonar detaches 2 materials as a Quick Effect on either turn to Special Summon any Number 1–100 monster from the Extra Deck (treated as an Xyz Summon), usually calling Number 38: Hope Harbinger Dragon Titanic Galaxy for Spell negation or Number 41: Bagooska the Terribly Tired Tapir.
Number 39: Utopia, Emissary of Light (Rank 4) can only be destroyed by battle with another Number monster, shields a monster from destruction, and steals monsters it destroys by battle.

Number F0: Utopic Draco Future and Number F0: Utopic Future Zexal overlay on top of two same-Rank non-Number Xyz Monsters to negate and steal monsters on the field, while Number S39: Utopia the Lightning attacks at 5000 ATK with opponent responses locked out.

summary.title: Spells, Traps & Left out
points: Astraltopia searches Numbers Protection, Unbreakable Xyz Barrier, or Shining Hope Road while an Xyz Monster is on the field; Numbers Protection and Unbreakable Xyz Barrier provide omni-negate Counter Traps while you control a Number/Xyz.
Left out: the Galaxy-Eyes Tachyon tournament engine is a separate deck, and Number C104: Umbral Horror Masquerade belongs with the Umbral Horror / Gorgonic Rank-Up strategy.

allow.Unbreakable Xyz Barrier: 2026 Counter Trap that Astraltopia searches; it negates and recycles a Utopia from the GY.

main: Utopic Onomatopoeia
Counts as every Onomat family: summons one of each from the hand.
Zubababa Knight
Summoned: searches a Zubaba and copies its Level; detached, searches a Gagaga.
Gagaga Ganbara Knight
Reveals a Gagaga Xyz to summon itself and another Gagaga; detached, searches a Gogogo.
ZS - Ascended Sage
Summons itself on an empty field; as Utopia material, searches Hyper Rank-Up-Magic Utopiforce.
Onomatokage
Counts as every Onomat family and summons itself next to one; recycles Xyz Monsters.
Zubababancho Gagagacoat
Summons itself next to a Zubaba or Gagaga and revives a Gogogo or Dododo.
Dodododwarf Gogogoglove
Summons a Zubaba or Gagaga from the hand; comes back from the GY.
Gogogo Goblindbergh
Normal Summoned: summons a Gogogo; detached, searches a Dododo.
Dodododo Warrior
Mills a Dododo to summon itself as a Level 4; detached, searches a Zubaba.
Astraltopia
Summons itself next to an Xyz and searches a Number, Onomat, Zexal or Xyz Spell/Trap.
Gagaga Girl - Cell Phone Subtraction
2026 support. Answers an Extra Deck summon with an instant Xyz Summon; detached, zeroes a monster.
Onomatopaira
Discards to search two Onomat monsters of different families.
Reinforcement of the Army
Limited. Searches ZS - Ascended Sage or an Onomat Warrior.
Hyper Rank-Up-Magic Utopiforce
Ranks a Utopia up into Number 99: Utopia Dragonar.
Shining Hope Road
Revives three monsters straight into a Utopia Xyz.
Numbers Protection
Counter Trap with a Number out; Sets itself again when a Number is destroyed.
Unbreakable Xyz Barrier
Counter Trap with an Xyz out; from the GY, attaches a Utopia.
extra: Number 39: Utopia, Emissary of Light
Newest support. Rank 4 that only another Number can destroy in battle; shields a monster and steals what it destroys.
Number 39: Utopia
Rank 4 Utopia for Utopiforce and Utopia the Lightning.
Number 39: Utopia Rising
Rank 4: revives a Number from the GY with its materials.
ZS - Utopic Sage
Rank 4: summons a ZS from the Deck and protects your Utopias.
Eclipse Twins
Generic Rank 4 on top of another; from the GY, revives two Rank 4s as one.
Number 41: Bagooska the Terribly Tired Tapir
Rank 4 Number that puts their monsters in Defense Position and negates them.
Number S39: Utopia the Lightning
Rank 5 on top of a Utopia: 5000 ATK with no response in battle.
Number 99: Utopia Dragonar
Rank 12 from Utopiforce: calls any Number 1-100 from the Extra Deck on either turn.
Number 38: Hope Harbinger Dragon Titanic Galaxy
Dragonar's usual call: negates a Spell and absorbs it.
Number F0: Utopic Future
Two same-Rank non-Number Xyz: the base for Utopic Draco Future.
Number F0: Utopic Draco Future
Negates a monster effect and steals the monster; can't be destroyed.
Number F0: Utopic Future Zexal
Two same-Rank Xyz: draws every attack and target, and steals a monster on their turn.
